turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm turning twenty five and I've got three ideas for the night, but I keep flip flopping.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Karaoke in a private booth with about ten friends and way too many snacks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A rooftop bar downtown, more grown up, people just drop by over the evening.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a house party at mine with a playlist everyone adds to beforehand.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you want a night you'll laugh about later, karaoke wins. If you'd rather lots of people pass through without pressure, the rooftop bar suits that. The house party is lovely but you'll spend half of it tidying cups.
